AAOS-GOV-01.title: General accounting product scope
AAOS-GOV-01.Description: Support the full accounting cycle through one reusable platform: GL, AP, AR, banking/reconciliation, close, reporting/analysis. Keep non-accounting executive and business-development agents outside this project.
AAOS-GOV-01.Business purpose: Build accounting staff/senior preparation and execution capacity reusable for clients beyond Bird Bowl.
AAOS-GOV-01.Status: Approved; the six-area design exists, full-cycle execution does not.
AAOS-GOV-01.Acceptance criteria: Each area has domain/control/extension contracts and truthful capability status; no card-only or Bird Bowl-only dependency prevents another client profile; deferred handlers cannot return fabricated success.
AAOS-GOV-01.Target stage: Current architecture; capability implementation progresses through the existing backlog and later assigned stages.

AAOS-GOV-02.title: Permanent traceable requirements
AAOS-GOV-02.Description: Maintain this register with stable IDs, all required fields, source/backlog traceability and retained change/rejection history.
AAOS-GOV-02.Business purpose: Prevent future requirements from disappearing between batches without displacing the active implementation plan.
AAOS-GOV-02.Status: Implemented by this documentation change; document checks recorded in PROGRESS.md.
AAOS-GOV-02.Acceptance criteria: All ten requested product areas and all T-01–T-27 tickets have a trace; agents must consult/update the register; decisions and progress name the current gate; rejected requirements retain an explanation.
AAOS-GOV-02.Target stage: Current; ongoing maintenance in each relevant change.

AAOS-GOV-03.title: Evidence-based release and preserved review gates
AAOS-GOV-03.Description: Keep developer tests, independent review, client sample validation, connected operation and human operating readiness separate; preserve original review evidence and frozen releases.
AAOS-GOV-03.Business purpose: Make trustworthy claims and prevent a feature or documentation change from widening authority.
AAOS-GOV-03.Status: Tested for current local gates/package guards; independent RA/G0 acceptance pending.
AAOS-GOV-03.Acceptance criteria: Existing original methods/regressions and exact assertions remain; known repaired defects must pass; unavailable capabilities remain explicitly deferred; original/adapted probe differences and nonzero original commands remain disclosed; no bundle overwrite or automatic G1/Batch 3 transition.
AAOS-GOV-03.Target stage: Current / G0; renewed at every subsequent gate.

AAOS-ARC-01.title: Shared execution and modular capabilities
AAOS-ARC-01.Description: Share deterministic accounting controls, tools, workflow DAGs and execution contracts while keeping client accounting knowledge/configuration separate.
AAOS-ARC-01.Business purpose: Add or validate a module/client without duplicating the core or redesigning the platform.
AAOS-ARC-01.Status: Tested for the local runner and registered card/journal/readiness workflows; full module coverage deferred.
AAOS-ARC-01.Acceptance criteria: Handlers use declared scoped inputs and committed dependency outputs; handler/model proposals cannot directly approve, query arbitrary client data or perform external effects; unimplemented modules return unavailable.
AAOS-ARC-01.Target stage: Current foundation; extend only in assigned capability tickets.

AAOS-ARC-02.title: Isolated client workspaces
AAOS-ARC-02.Description: Scope identities, records, policies, credentials, memory, jobs, evidence, approvals, retrieval and exports by organization/client/environment, with entity/book where accounting requires it.
AAOS-ARC-02.Business purpose: Reuse one codebase without exposing or mixing client information or authority.
AAOS-ARC-02.Status: Tested for synthetic backend scoping; real-client storage and authentication remain deferred.
AAOS-ARC-02.Acceptance criteria: Two clients in different periods have no cross-effects; denied object IDs/search/export/job references fail server-side; real-client storage uses validated per-client databases or a server store with enforced isolation/per-client credentials rather than assuming a scope column suffices.
AAOS-ARC-02.Target stage: Current synthetic controls; production isolation before real client records/G1 and hosted G2.

AAOS-ARC-03.title: Central Supporting Strategies deployment
AAOS-ARC-03.Description: Support one centrally operated Accounting Agent OS deployment with isolated client workspaces and authorized firm management views.
AAOS-ARC-03.Business purpose: Operate multiple accounting clients without separate code forks or importing the unrelated SS agent system.
AAOS-ARC-03.Status: Approved product architecture; no hosted deployment implemented.
AAOS-ARC-03.Acceptance criteria: A second client onboards using scoped configuration on the same release; administrators and managers have explicit access; workload, storage, cost and authorization boundaries survive concurrent clients; deployment has a named company authority/owner.
AAOS-ARC-03.Target stage: Future / unassigned; hosting/readiness work before G2, separately authorized.

AAOS-ARC-04.title: Optional independent client deployment
AAOS-ARC-04.Description: Allow a Bird Bowl or other client deployment from the same accounting codebase, containing only its authorized accounting modules/data and its own scoped configuration.
AAOS-ARC-04.Business purpose: Accommodate a client's hosting/support arrangement without creating a client-specific product fork or central-system dependency.
AAOS-ARC-04.Status: Approved option; actual Bird Bowl host and support arrangement unselected.
AAOS-ARC-04.Acceptance criteria: Accounting can operate without an SS backlink; no SS executive/CRM/other-client data or shared credentials are preloaded; any later backlink names its purpose, exact data scope and authority.
AAOS-ARC-04.Target stage: Future / unassigned; separate hosting authorization and G2/G4 controls.

AAOS-ARC-05.title: Environment and release separation
AAOS-ARC-05.Description: Separate local, evaluation/sample, staging and production records, secrets, queues, budgets, grants, evidence and approvals; promote code/configuration through reviewed releases.
AAOS-ARC-05.Business purpose: Prevent demo identities, fixture policy or test authority from becoming operational permission.
AAOS-ARC-05.Status: Deferred for hosted environments; local-only restrictions exist.
AAOS-ARC-05.Acceptance criteria: Hosted startup rejects demo identity/insecure configuration; promotion does not copy live credentials, sample approval flags or enabled schedules; reviewed migrations and rollback preserve evidence/decisions/jobs and identify compatibility limits.
AAOS-ARC-05.Target stage: Before approved samples as applicable and any hosted G2 environment.

AAOS-EXE-01.title: Durable progress and resumable work
AAOS-EXE-01.Description: Persist tasks, steps, dependencies, memory/checkpoints, current outcomes and historical evidence across application/worker restarts.
AAOS-EXE-01.Business purpose: Complete work across days without restarting from chat context or losing blocked work.
AAOS-EXE-01.Status: Tested in local synthetic SQLite workflows.
AAOS-EXE-01.Acceptance criteria: A restart resumes committed work without duplicate artifacts/effects; a blocker pauses dependent work while unrelated authorized work continues; run/step/exception status explains the next required action.
AAOS-EXE-01.Target stage: Current / G0; production recovery separately validated.
AAOS-EXE-01.Trace: ARCH; FABLE T-04/T-14; LEGACY durable workflow.

AAOS-EXE-02.title: Recurring occurrences and event wake-up
AAOS-EXE-02.Description: Separate each business occurrence from its execution attempts; support calendar/scheduled and evidence/dependency events with deduplication.
AAOS-EXE-02.Business purpose: Retry or resume legitimate routine work without double-processing or requiring a new user prompt.
AAOS-EXE-02.Status: Tested with a persisted simulated clock/events; no real scheduler active.
AAOS-EXE-02.Acceptance criteria: One completed execution per occurrence; held work can redispatch after its prerequisites change; unfit mandates do not stop other clients/work; missed slots and catch-up policy are explicit; retries do not reset unfinished-work limits.
AAOS-EXE-02.Target stage: Current simulation; live triggers only after separate schedule/event authorization and hosted readiness.
AAOS-EXE-02.Trace: FABLE T-04/T-10; ARCH; LEGACY recurrence controls.

AAOS-EXE-03.title: Bounded standing authority
AAOS-EXE-03.Description: Use independently approved mandates naming workflow, client/environment, period selection, policy windows, fresh-evidence predicates, limits, expiry, review requirements and revocation.
AAOS-EXE-03.Business purpose: Permit routine authorized work autonomously while preserving consequential human decisions.
AAOS-EXE-03.Status: Tested for synthetic mandates; real authority and grant lifecycle unconfigured.
AAOS-EXE-03.Acceptance criteria: Proposed/model-authored mandates confer no authority; stale/missing required evidence waits; a no-evidence exception needs an independent explicit reason; relevant policy change suspends for reconfirmation, unrelated/future changes do not; source arrival alone does not falsely change approved policy; expiry/revocation prevents further authorized dispatch.
AAOS-EXE-03.Target stage: Current / G0 controls; validated real mandates and separately authorized triggers before unattended operation/G4.

AAOS-EXE-04.title: Hosted unattended operation
AAOS-EXE-04.Description: Run authorized scheduled/event-driven accounting work on persistent hosted infrastructure without the user's computer or active chat session.
AAOS-EXE-04.Business purpose: Make overnight work and continuing accounting execution dependable.
AAOS-EXE-04.Status: Approved product outcome; hosted runtime, schedules and monitoring are not implemented/activated.
AAOS-EXE-04.Dependencies: AAOS-EXE-01; AAOS-EXE-02; AAOS-EXE-03; AAOS-EXE-05; AAOS-ARC-05; AAOS-CTL-02; AAOS-CTL-13; AAOS-OBS-03.
AAOS-EXE-04.Acceptance criteria: A witnessed run completes its authorized portion while the user's computer is off; work/evidence survive host restart; unavailable inputs/services produce durable exceptions; health, failure notification, backup/restore and stop controls operate within the agreed authority/cost ceiling.
AAOS-EXE-04.Target stage: Future / unassigned; authorized hosted G2 setup, separate schedule authority, observed G4 handoff.
AAOS-EXE-04.Trace: U; PILOT readiness; LEGACY hosting/durable work; FABLE T-24/T-27.

AAOS-EXE-05.title: Production retries, leases and monitoring
AAOS-EXE-05.Description: Classify transient failures versus deterministic accounting holds, persist bounded backoff, heartbeat/fence worker leases and keep the worker alive with observable health/errors.
AAOS-EXE-05.Business purpose: Avoid duplicate or silently abandoned work after faults and outages.
AAOS-EXE-05.Status: Deferred; local checkpoints/leases exist, production lifecycle guarantees do not.
AAOS-EXE-05.Acceptance criteria: Transient retries retain counts/next wake; deterministic failures do not loop; a lease loser cannot commit; a failed job does not kill independent work; stalled work has a deterministic monitor and assigned escalation; recovery tests preserve one valid business result.
AAOS-EXE-05.Target stage: Existing Batch 3 / T-24, not authorized; hosted validation before G2/G4.

AAOS-EXE-06.title: Pause, cancellation and operational controls
AAOS-EXE-06.Description: Provide distinct controls for pausing new work, stopping a run, disabling triggers/connectors and revoking authority/approvals, with durable reasons and truthful in-flight status.
AAOS-EXE-06.Business purpose: Let operators contain a failure or policy change without losing completed evidence or suggesting irreversible actions were undone.
AAOS-EXE-06.Status: Approved; current local controls cover only parts of this operational set.
AAOS-EXE-06.Acceptance criteria: Each control is independently tested; pending versus dispatched/unknown outcomes remain visible; cancellation cannot claim reversal of a completed external effect; independent unaffected authorized work may continue.
AAOS-EXE-06.Target stage: Future / unassigned; relevant controls required before hosted/live actions.
AAOS-EXE-06.Trace: LEGACY stop controls/uncertain outcomes; FABLE T-24; ARCH limits.

AAOS-EXE-07.title: Deterministic execution and optional model proposals
AAOS-EXE-07.Description: Declare each step deterministic, model-assisted or human. Keep math, rules, authority and supported connector execution in application-owned code; model output remains untrusted proposals.
AAOS-EXE-07.Business purpose: Support valid zero-model workflows and avoid making accounting execution depend on a subscription or model conversation.
AAOS-EXE-07.Status: Tested for the current zero-model/no-egress path; model adapters and model evaluation deferred.
AAOS-EXE-07.Acceptance criteria: Deterministic approved paths run with outbound calls denied; missing model access cannot cause guessing or bypass a required model review; model requests pass trusted scope/schema/evidence/authority checks; model/critic output never becomes human approval.
AAOS-EXE-07.Target stage: Current deterministic foundation; any model integration requires later explicit scope/cost authorization.
AAOS-EXE-07.Trace: PILOT application/model roles; LEGACY §6E/10; ARCH; T-09/T-10.

AAOS-KNO-01.title: Applicable framework and reusable accounting knowledge
AAOS-KNO-01.Description: Represent applicable framework, basis, jurisdiction/entity/book and reusable accounting principles separately from client-specific treatments and workflows.
AAOS-KNO-01.Business purpose: Ground work in the right accounting context without declaring one client's treatment universal.
AAOS-KNO-01.Status: Approved; framework/basis fact gates exist, a complete accounting knowledge service does not.
AAOS-KNO-01.Acceptance criteria: Each applicable treatment identifies the governing client context; missing/conflicting framework/basis is held; reusable invariants are distinguished from professional judgment/client policy; no framework, threshold or tax conclusion is silently assigned to Bird Bowl or a new client.
AAOS-KNO-01.Target stage: Future / unassigned knowledge capability; actual facts required at G1.

AAOS-KNO-02.title: Verified standards references
AAOS-KNO-02.Description: Maintain authoritative reference identity, edition/effective dates, applicable passage, verification date, reviewer and supporting evidence for standards-dependent treatments.
AAOS-KNO-02.Business purpose: Make accounting reasoning reviewable and prevent a model's remembered citation from becoming policy.
AAOS-KNO-02.Status: Approved; no operational standards-reference verification service implemented.
AAOS-KNO-02.Acceptance criteria: The accounting lead verifies references against authoritative material and applicability before reliance; expired/conflicting/unverified references are visible and cannot silently activate a rule; reference changes trigger review of dependent treatments; access/licensing restrictions are respected.
AAOS-KNO-02.Target stage: Future / unassigned; before relying on standards-driven live treatment.
AAOS-KNO-02.Trace: U; FABLE §13 (review citations were not re-fetched); docs/SOURCES.md.

AAOS-KNO-03.Business purpose: Onboard any client without rebuilding shared code or filling missing facts with plausible assumptions.
AAOS-KNO-03.Status: Tested for scoped proposed profiles/required-fact gates and fictional chart/entity/book; full master-data onboarding deferred.
AAOS-KNO-03.Acceptance criteria: Capability prerequisites identify required facts; actual client-sample work cannot waive missing facts into eligibility; synthetic waivers are explanatory/exported and cannot migrate to real profiles; chart/mapping/system facts require authorized validation.

AAOS-KNO-04.title: Independently approved effective policies
AAOS-KNO-04.Description: Propose, independently approve, supersede/retire and load client policies, treatment rules, vendor mappings, receipt rules and procedure versions by effective window and relevant scope.
AAOS-KNO-04.Business purpose: Convert validated knowledge into controlled reusable execution without allowing a preparer/model to activate its own advice.
AAOS-KNO-04.Status: Tested for synthetic profile/rule lifecycle, retirement and semantic authorship lineage.
AAOS-KNO-04.Acceptance criteria: Unapproved rules cannot code approvable work; aliases/normalization/collisions are visible before approval; withdrawn mappings stop applying in their effective scope; prior relevant authors/approvers remain contributors even after cosmetic or unlinked re-proposal; item-date and workflow relevance select the applicable versions.
AAOS-KNO-04.Target stage: Current / G0; real policies separately validated/approved at G1.

AAOS-KNO-05.title: Decisions and scoped correction history
AAOS-KNO-05.Description: Preserve item-specific decisions, rationale, source support, approver, effective version, correction scope and superseded guidance separately from reusable approved rules.
AAOS-KNO-05.Business purpose: Learn from interventions without silently generalizing a one-off accounting judgment.
AAOS-KNO-05.Status: Tested for local immutable decisions/dispositions and proposed-rule separation; complete client playbook capture not validated.
AAOS-KNO-05.Acceptance criteria: Every correction states single-item versus reusable scope; history survives rejection/revocation/supersession; a proposed reusable rule does not resolve an exception or authorize itself; repeat work uses only the approved applicable guidance.
AAOS-KNO-05.Target stage: Current controls; client knowledge capture/validation at G1/G4.

AAOS-KNO-06.title: Portable operating knowledge and coverage
AAOS-KNO-06.Description: Export a maintained knowledge package with approved procedures, checklists, mappings, examples, decisions, support scripts/templates, operator/support guides and separate validation cases/coverage gaps.

AAOS-GL-01.title: Shared proposed-entry contract
AAOS-GL-01.Description: Represent proposed accounting effects with entity/book, origin, period/date, currency, accounts, debit/credit lines, dimensions, rationale, rule/evidence references and review/external status.

AAOS-GL-03.Description: Progressively support general transaction classification, accruals, adjustments, reversals, account-maintenance proposals and authorized ledger execution under client-specific treatment rules.

AAOS-OBS-01.title: Work, accuracy, exceptions and human effort
AAOS-OBS-01.Description: Measure task coverage/completion, accounting accuracy, defects/missed exceptions/false positives, required versus unnecessary interruptions and human preparation/review/correction/training/maintenance time.
